entries.category_description: Medical equipment, aids and other appliances normally intended to alleviate or treat disability, for the exclusive personal use of the disabled, including the repair of such goods
entries.code_description: Soap; organic surface-active products and preparations for use as soap, in the form of bars, cakes, moulded pieces or shapes, whether or not containing soap; organic surface-active products and preparations for washing the skin, in the form of liquid or cream and put up for retail sale, whether or not containing soap; paper, wadding, felt and nonwovens, impregnated, coated or covered with soap or detergent
entries.comment: This reduced rate applies only to ostomy care products (part 3): —Tracheostomy care products : — filters for tracheostomy, neck bands for tracheostomy, speaking and swallowing valves; 9019 20 00, 9021 90 90, 6307 —foam dressings and patches for tracheostomy; 3005 10 00 — skin cleansing patches for tracheostomy; 3401 19 00 — protective layer for the skin surrounding tracheostomy; 3401 — tracheostomy protectors; 9018 90 84 — aspiration probes ; 9018 39 00 — tracheal cannulas ; 9018 39 00.
